propositions: Add an immutable, versioned, non-secret OperationSnapshot type that composes validated effective configuration values with explicit source-kind provenance from five layers (explicit input, environment, project config, user config, schema default) without storing secrets, live clients, or source-file paths.

Thread the snapshot through CLI, public library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points in shadow mode, with legacy execution remaining authoritative and shadow failures isolated via catch/redact to prevent execution disruption.

The snapshot composition prefers explicit operation input over environment over project config over user config over schema default, and selects repository root independently via explicit repo_root parameter or REBAR_ROOT environment variable or Git discovery.

Malformed selected operation config raises typed config error before lock/network/write; all other snapshot assembly/fingerprint/diagnostic failures in shadow mode emit only redacted warnings containing no secrets or paths.

The temporary REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW switch is enabled by default and must be set to canonical false to restore legacy behavior; it is removed in S7 and does not persist snapshot data or alter ticket/bridge formats.
